evolution-x-6.6.author: Evolution-X
evolution-x-6.6.rom_support: Evolution X builds running kernel 6.6 only
evolution-x-6.6.notes: Evolution X kernel 6.6 (branch cnb-6.6). The ROM uses a Kleaf mixed build: boot.img carries the pure GKI kernel_aarch64 Image (gki_defconfig, no vendor fragments), and vendor/system_dlkm modules are built against its KMI. So the Image must be plain gki_defconfig. MODULE_SIG_PROTECT is disabled because a self-built Image cannot verify the ROM's signed system_dlkm GKI modules, which would then be refused (-EACCES) when they export protected symbols. MODULE_ALLOW_BTF_MISMATCH (set by gki_defconfig) is required because our vmlinux BTF can't match the ROM's byte for byte. DEBUG_INFO_BTF_MODULES must stay on (needs pahole >= 1.21) or struct module changes and every vendor module is rejected. The tree ships KernelSU-Next in drivers/kernelsu; it is removed before a manager's setup.sh runs, otherwise the selected manager is silently ignored.
